about_the_game: You ever sit down, hungry because you haven't eaten all day, open a hot bag of fast food burgers and crispy salted fries, and enjoy it as if it was the best meal ever? Fantasy Formula offers this beautiful sensation just on a different level as it brings your favorite fast food restaurants to life as voluptuous supernatural managers that each have unique personalities of their own!

content_descriptors.notes: Mature content consists of suggestive themes, nudity, sexual acts/performances, BDSM, light non-consensual assault/sex themes, light horror themes, light sexual violence, self harm, and use of alcohol.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10 Yosemite or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo (2.0 GHz) or newer (Apple Silicon M1/M2 fully supported via Rosetta or native build)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 2.0 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz dual-core) or Apple Silicon M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (or Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (32 or 64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz dual-core processor (Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2 or newer)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 2.0 support (Intel HD 3000+ or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
